title: The Long Lantern
author: Astrid Whitlock
blurb: Emrys Villalobos, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
